scope: One localhost-only non-GPU /bin/true per long/short TMPDIR, no Slurm/srun/science; --host localhost and plm_rsh_agent=/bin/false prevent remote SSH launch.
shell_script:
set -euo pipefail
source /etc/profile.d/lmod.sh
module use /opt/modules/modulefiles/devtools
module load openmpi/5.0.10-nvhpc26.3-gnu-cuda12-auto
module -t list
mpirun --version
python3 - <<'ENV'
import json,os
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith(('OMPI_','PMIX_','PRTE_','PMI_')) or k in ('PATH','LD_LIBRARY_PATH','TMPDIR','TMP','TEMP','MPI_HOME','OPAL_PREFIX')},sort_keys=True))
ENV
exec /usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=5s 30s mpirun --host localhost --prtemca plm_rsh_agent /bin/false --report-bindings -np 1 /bin/true
